items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So he joined the band. It was a whole new concept. It was like me and him were swinging

ctx.x: So he joined the band. It was a whole new concept. It was like me and him were swinging, and Smitty fell right in. The band was swinging like crazy with Simon. Because these people would usually use the bass drum, and here this man's playing these big, heavy notes, man, big, fat notes, and didn't say nothin'... The first day Simon come there, he said he didn't like the city, he said, "'cause all the buildings looks like hospitals."
That was the only big buildings down here, I guess.
